set.affordability_requirement: Sliding scale by project size: 3 to 10 units 10%, then one percentage point per unit from 11 units (11%) to 20 or more units (20%). Rental projects: half of the required units at 50% AMI rents and half at 60% AMI rents (very low and low income). Ownership: half low income (65% AMI pricing) and half moderate income (90% AMI pricing). Fractions of 0.70 or more round up. Affordable units restricted for a minimum of 99 years from first occupancy (rental) or first sale (ownership) unless state law requires a shorter term (19.24.070E), through a recorded Inclusionary Housing Agreement; one-for-one replacement of demolished deed-restricted units. Exempt: ADUs and JADUs, residential care facilities for the elderly, single or two-unit projects with homes of 3,000 square feet or less, and AHO overlay projects that meet the overlay's 20% requirement.
